title: Concise-9B: Removing the Slack from a Reasoning Model's Thinking
abstract: arXiv:2611.02278v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning models answer better when they think longer, but a thinking trace keeps going well after its answer has formed. We measure this slack in Qwen3.5-9B and remove most of it with concise self-training: two rounds of on-policy rejection-sampling fine-tuning that keep the shortest correct samples, plus a small share of answer-synthesis targets, giving Concise-9B. On 8,983 held-out problems (competition and hard mathematics, SuperGPQA, a five-area confirmation set and MMLU-Pro), Concise-9B generates 0.66x the tokens of Qwen3.5-9B at a 32K thinking budget, with accuracy equivalent within +/-1 point (-0.20 [-0.77, +0.36] points). Forcing each trace on the hard and confirmation sets to answer every 2,048 thinking tokens, we find that 54-64% of Qwen3.5-9B's thinking tokens come after the point from which every forced answer equals the final one (41-48% for Concise-9B). Stopping there would keep every answer at 0.35-0.44x the base model'

translated_title: Concise-9B：消除推理模型思维过程中的冗余
translated_abstract: 推理模型在思考更久时回答效果更好，但思维链在答案已经形成之后仍会继续运行。我们测量了Qwen3.5-9B中的这种冗余，并通过简洁自训练（concise self-training）将其大部分消除：即两轮策略上拒绝采样微调，保留最短的正确样本，再加上一小部分答案合成目标，从而得到Concise-9B。在8,983个保留测试问题上（竞赛及困难数学、SuperGPQA、一个五领域确认集以及MMLU-Pro），Concise-9B在32K思考预算下生成的token数量仅为Qwen3.5-9B的0.66倍，而准确率等效（差异在±1分以内，即-0.20 [-0.77, +0.36]分）。通过让困难集和确认集上的每条思维链每2,048个思考token强制作答一次，我们发现Qwen3.5-9B有54-64%的思考token出现在“从该点起所有强制答案均等于最终答案”的时刻之后（Concise-9B为41-48%）。在该点停止思考将使每个答案的token量保持在基础模型的0.35-0.44倍。
tldr: 提出Concise-9B模型，通过简洁自训练方法（两轮策略上拒绝采样微调并保留最短正确样本）去除推理模型思维链中的冗余部分，在保持准确率等效的前提下将生成token量降至原模型的0.66倍。
